description: The company's confirmed answers to the security questions customers ask in supplier risk assessments (yes / partial / no / not applicable, with details), for one service (company-wide answers included). Each answer has a stable question_key (IVERIOS question bank qb-2) and domain. Approved visitors see the services their access includes.

domain.description: Optional domain filter (e.g. access, data, incident, continuity)

language.description: Optional language code for translated content (bg, cs, da, de, el, en, es, et, fi, fr, ga, hr, hu, it, lt, lv, mt, nl, pl, pt, ro, sk, sl, sv). Defaults to the original language.

service_id.description: Service id from list_services; optional when the company has one service

trust_center.description: Trust center id (from list_trust_centers), its domain or the exact company name.

name: get_answers
title: Answers to customer due-diligence questions
